#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native-spacecraft validation of in-house MHD, with no Parker remapping.

Run after simulations finish, e.g. python observations/analyze_native_model.py.
All paired observations occur on/after Nov25 (after normalization training).
Outputs: validation/inhouse_native.{json,tsv,png,pdf} under the project root.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from astropy.time import Time
from case_selection import CASE_PRIORITY, NONPHYSICAL_EXPORT_CASES, case_provenance, completed, select_case

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent
FIELDS = {"density_cm3": ("density_cm3", "n_cm3", 4), "speed_km_s": ("speed_km_s", "speed_kms", 14), "flux_cm2_s": ("proton_flux_cm2_s", "flux_cm2_s", 15)}
MONITORS = {"wind": (1, "earth"), "stereo_a": (2, "stereoa"), "solar_orbiter": (3, "solo")}


def metric(o, p):
    mask = np.isfinite(o) & np.isfinite(p) & (o > 0) & (p > 0)
    o, p = np.asarray(o)[mask], np.asarray(p)[mask]
    if len(o) < 2:
        return {"samples": len(o)}
    return {"samples": len(o), "observed_median": float(np.median(o)), "model_median": float(np.median(p)), "median_model_over_observed": float(np.median(p/o)), "observed_over_model_p16_50_84": np.percentile(o/p,[16,50,84]).tolist(), "observed_minus_model_p16_50_84": np.percentile(o-p,[16,50,84]).tolist(), "median_absolute_fractional_error": float(np.median(abs(p/o-1))), "rmse": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((p-o)**2))), "pearson_r": float(np.corrcoef(o,p)[0,1]), "log_pearson_r": float(np.corrcoef(np.log(o),np.log(p))[0,1]), "rms_log_ratio": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.log(p/o)**2)))}


def average_at_native(stamps, native_monitor, times, values):
    """Mean model over each native hour, rejecting extrapolation or large gaps."""
    base = stamps - (0.5/24 if native_monitor == "wind" else 0)
    quadrature = base[:,None] + np.linspace(0,1/24,61)[None,:]
    valid = (quadrature[:,0] >= times.min()) & (quadrature[:,-1] <= times.max())
    # Probe output is hourly; a missing sample must not silently bridge >90min.
    gaps = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(times) > 1.5/24)
    for gap in gaps:
        valid &= (quadrature[:,-1] <= times[gap]) | (quadrature[:,0] >= times[gap+1])
    result = np.full(len(stamps), np.nan)
    if np.any(valid):
        result[valid] = np.trapezoid(np.interp(quadrature[valid],times,values),dx=1/60,axis=1)
    return result


def load_probes(path, origin):
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    with path.open() as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    if not rows:
        return None
    ans = {}
    for name,(number,target) in MONITORS.items():
        selected = [r for r in rows if int(r["probe_id"]) == number]
        if not selected:
            continue
        timecol = "day" if "day" in selected[0] else "tday"
        time = np.array([float(r[timecol])+origin for r in selected])
        order = np.argsort(time)
        time = time[order]
        if np.any(np.diff(time) <= 0):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Nonunique probe times: {path} {name}")
        ans[name] = {"mjd":time,**{field:np.array([float(r[spec[1]]) for r in selected])[order] for field,spec in FIELDS.items()}}
    return ans


def make_plot(records, preferred_case, output):
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    import matplotlib.dates as mdates
    colors = {"inhouse":"#D55E00", "ccmc":"#0072B2", "observed":"#20242A"}
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(3,3,figsize=(14,9),sharex=True,constrained_layout=True)
    titles = {"wind":"Wind / OMNI (held out)","stereo_a":"STEREO-A","solar_orbiter":"Solar Orbiter"}
    labels = {"density_cm3":"Proton density (cm$^{-3}$)","speed_km_s":"Speed (km s$^{-1}$)","flux_cm2_s":"Proton flux (cm$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$)"}

        for j,field in enumerate(FIELDS):

            ax.plot(t,[r["inhouse_"+field] for r in use],color=colors["inhouse"],lw=1.4,label="In-house MHD ("+preferred_case+")")
            ax.plot(t,[r["ccmc_ambient_"+field] for r in use],color=colors["ccmc"],lw=1.1,alpha=.9,label="CCMC ambient")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit observer-arrival versus comet-emission UTC for a selected completed case.

No model, ephemeris, GTI, empirical-validation or plot inputs are changed. The
default output replaces the historical light_travel_time_audit.json only when
this script is explicitly run without --check-selection or --self-test.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import csv
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from astropy.time import Time
from case_selection import case_provenance, select_case

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=HERE.parent
AU_KM=149597870.7
C_KM_S=299792.458
DAY_S=86400.
FIELDS=('n_cm3','speed_kms','flux_cm2_s','incident_flux_cm2_s')
UNITS={'n_cm3':'cm^-3','speed_kms':'km s^-1','flux_cm2_s':'cm^-2 s^-1','incident_flux_cm2_s':'cm^-2 s^-1'}
ORBIT_SOURCE='https://xmm-tools.cosmos.esa.int/external/xmm_user_support/documentation/uhb/orbit.html'

def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def table(path,delimiter='\t'):
    return np.genfromtxt(path,names=True,delimiter=delimiter,dtype=None,encoding='utf8')

def checked_interpolate(query,times,values,label):
    query=np.asarray(query,dtype=float)
    if np.any(~np.isfinite(query)) or query.min()<times[0]-1e-11 or query.max()>times[-1]+1e-11:
        raise ValueError(f'{label}: requested epochs are outside source coverage; no extrapolation permitted')
    if values.ndim==1:return np.interp(query,times,values)
    return np.stack([np.interp(query,times,values[:,j]) for j in range(values.shape[1])],axis=-1)

def emission_time(arrival,comet_position,earth_position):
    """Solve te=to-|rC(te)-rEarth(to)|/c in common geometric coordinates."""
    arrival=np.asarray(arrival,dtype=float);observer=earth_position(arrival);emission=arrival.copy()
    for _ in range(12):
        delay=np.linalg.norm(comet_position(emission)-observer,axis=-1)*AU_KM/C_KM_S/DAY_S
        updated=arrival-delay
        if np.max(abs(updated-emission))<1e-12:return updated
        emission=updated
    raise ValueError('Comet-emission light-time iteration did not converge')

def arrival_time(emission,comet_position,earth_position):
    """Invert the retarded mapping to include every shifted native probe knot."""
    emission=np.asarray(emission,dtype=float);source=comet_position(emission);arrival=emission.copy()
    for _ in range(12):
        updated=emission+np.linalg.norm(source-earth_position(arrival),axis=-1)*AU_KM/C_KM_S/DAY_S
        if np.max(abs(updated-arrival))<1e-12:return updated
        arrival=updated
    raise ValueError('Observer-arrival light-time iteration did not converge')

class Inputs:
    def __init__(self,case):
        self.metadata=json.loads((ROOT/'inputs/metadata.json').read_text())
        self.origin=float(self.metadata['origin_mjd_utc'])
        self.matrix=np.asarray(json.loads((HERE/'coordinate_system.json').read_text())['ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix'])
        self.comet=table(HERE/'ephemeris_comet.tsv');self.earth=table(HERE/'ephemeris_wind.tsv')
        self.comet_time=self.comet['mjd_utc']-self.origin;self.earth_time=self.earth['mjd_utc']-self.origin
        self.comet_xyz=np.column_stack([self.comet[k] for k in ['x_au','y_au','z_au']])
        self.earth_xyz=np.column_stack([self.earth[k] for k in ['x_au','y_au','z_au']])
        self.comet_vxyz=np.column_stack([self.comet[k] for k in ['vx_au_day','vy_au_day','vz_au_day']])*AU_KM/DAY_S
        a=table(ROOT/f'results/{case}/probe.csv',',');a=a[a['probe_id']==0]
        time_name='day' if 'day' in a.dtype.names else 'tday'
        order=np.argsort(a[time_name]);a=a[order];self.probe_time=np.asarray(a[time_name],dtype=float)
        if len(a)<2 or np.any(np.diff(self.probe_time)<=0):raise ValueError('Need unique ordered comet probe samples')
        self.n=np.asarray(a['n_cm3'],dtype=float)
        self.wind_local=np.column_stack([a[k] for k in ['vr_kms','vtheta_kms','vphi_kms']])
        if np.any(~np.isfinite(self.wind_local)) or np.any(~np.isfinite(self.n)) or np.any(self.n<=0):raise ValueError('Invalid comet probe state')
        derived_speed=np.linalg.norm(self.wind_local,axis=1)
        self.native_consistency={'maximum_relative_speed_column_error':float(np.max(abs(derived_speed/a['speed_kms']-1))),'maximum_relative_flux_column_error':float(np.max(abs(self.n*derived_speed*1e5/a['flux_cm2_s']-1)))}

    def comet_position(self,t):return checked_interpolate(t,self.comet_time,self.comet_xyz,'Comet geometric ephemeris')
    def earth_position(self,t):return checked_interpolate(t,self.earth_time,self.earth_xyz,'Earth geometric ephemeris')
    def emission(self,t):return emission_time(t,self.comet_position,self.earth_position)
    def arrival(self,t):return arrival_time(t,self.comet_position,self.earth_position)
    def utc(self,t):return Time(np.asarray(t)+self.origin,format='mjd',scale='utc').isot

    def evaluate(self,t):
        """All density/velocity/ephemeris quantities refer to the same comet UTC."""
        t=np.asarray(t,dtype=float)

        local=checked_interpolate(t,self.probe_time,self.wind_local,'Comet MHD velocity')

def breakpoint_grid(start,stop,knots,maximum_step_seconds=None):
